page.overview:
What is Hyarrostar?

Hyarrostar ('Southeastlands') was the south-easterly cape-province of Númenor.

It was a widely spread country with wide white sanded beaches on the coastlands. The river Siril ran down through the western part of the region through the township of Nindamos. This part of Númenor was best known for its extensive tree plantations most of which were used as timber for the building of the great ships of the mariners of Númenor.
